hypotheses.R1_no_address_aggregation_recovers_stron: For first, minimum, median, and maximum address channel K90, absolute Spearman correlation with outlier excess remains below 0.60.
hypotheses.R2_strong_outliers_have_a_small_first_ad: The first cleaned address has channel K90 at most 64 in all three strongest-outlier layers.
hypotheses.R3_outlier_natural_use_relation_is_weak_: Every leave-one-layer-out excess-versus-use Spearman correlation remains below 0.60.
hypotheses.R4_sign_null_top_channel_recurrence_is_s: At least eight layers use the same top native channel in all four independent sign nulls.
hypotheses.R5_late_layers_form_a_compact_program_ph: Late median operator and channel K90 are each at most one quarter of their middle-layer medians.
hypotheses.R6_late_compactness_is_not_explained_by_: Late median leading log excess is lower than middle median leading log excess.
